values.binNote: Wiki description text does not state a numeric stun duration in the visible tooltip; the bin's StunDuration (0.35) is the only source for this number, distinct from the 0.4s reveal duration mentioned in text.

mechanics.claim: Rammus stops rolling upon colliding with an enemy, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies and knocking them back.
mechanics.quote: Rammus stops rolling upon colliding with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} 125 units

mechanics.claim: The damage is dealt only once, on collision, as an AoE burst rather than throughout the channel.
mechanics.quote: Rammus stops rolling upon colliding with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Powerball can be recast after 1 second within the duration, ending the roll early and (presumably) skipping the collision damage if no enemy was hit.
mechanics.quote: ''Powerball'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards

mechanics.claim: The initial cast and manual recast each count as separate ability activations for on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}

mechanics.claim: Cooldown begins only after the effect (roll) ends, not on initial cast.
